features.purpose: Assign sections, requests, responsibilities and references.
features.authorizationImplications: Current member/role and response workspace authority required.
features.uiImplications: Port task UX only after domain commands exist.

features.purpose: Server preflight, submitter authority and committed receipt.
features.authorizationImplications: Current response permission, opportunity state, synchronized version.
features.uiImplications: Port preflight and receipt UX only.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Atomic Firestore transaction, replay, stale version, storage attachment guard.

features.purpose: Open governed issuer channel and record explicit self-reported confirmation.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Future external-submission command/event state in RFxchange.
features.authorizationImplications: Current opportunity source and responder authority required.
features.uiImplications: Port differentiated external flow; never manufacture hosted receipt.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Governed URL, self-report disclosure, later verification separation.

features.purpose: Local draft/attachments with explicit promotion to shared workspace.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Client-side continuity layer subordinate to Firebase canonical state.
features.dataImplications: No browser data bulk migration; explicit verified-user/organization import only.
features.authorizationImplications: Local state grants no authority; promotion revalidates membership and versions.
features.uiImplications: Port interruption-safe behavior, not local canonical truth.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Conflict UX, no cross-org leakage, offline labels, cleanup/rollback.

features.purpose: Community/institutional vs commercial and participation policy.
features.dataImplications: Classification values may migrate as reviewed manifest fields, not SQL rows.
features.authorizationImplications: Classification never grants provider authority, verification or commercial entitlement.
features.uiImplications: Admin review UI may reuse donor language after domain model addition.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Rules, review fallback, commercial neutrality, audit.

features.testRfxFeature: Provider ingestion, deduplication and controlled promotion
features.purpose: Stage source candidates, compare canonical organizations and promote explicitly.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: New Firestore import staging collections and protected migration commands feeding existing canonical collections.
features.dataImplications: Export versioned manifests with source ID, provenance, hash and review state.
features.authorizationImplications: Admin/migration authority only; no browser promotion; tenant/public reads denied.
features.uiImplications: Port review workflow concepts; no SQL/API implementation.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Idempotency, duplicate/conflict counts, dry run, emulator, audit.

features.purpose: Source-backed organizations, locations, provider types and provenance.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Versioned migration manifest consumed by Firebase Admin import tool.
features.dataImplications: Migrate real source-backed records only; preserve source IDs, authority, timestamps and hashes; exclude fixtures.
features.authorizationImplications: Migration admin authority; promotion through canonical server commands.
features.uiImplications: No UI port required beyond existing unclaimed/provider presentation.

features.purpose: Accept only unambiguous state/ZIP-consistent points; review uncertainty.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Versioned geocode decisions plus controlled organization-location commands and Mapbox projection.
features.dataImplications: Migrate accepted/review/failed outcomes and provenance; never centroid fallback.
features.authorizationImplications: Migration/admin review authority; public marker only after canonical accepted location.
features.uiImplications: No MapLibre code; existing Mapbox projection consumes canonical location.
features.acceptanceCriteria: 22/1/7 baseline reconciliation, point precision, review workflow, emulator.

features.testRfxFeature: Unclaimed provider listing and claim handoff
features.purpose: Show source-backed unclaimed state and route to canonical organization claim.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Existing organization authority claims and Resource provider projections.
features.dataImplications: Claim state maps to canonical organization claim records; no Resource-specific claim store.
features.authorizationImplications: Current verified user, claim methods, evidence and admin review.
features.uiImplications: Adapt unclaimed visual/copy and return context.
features.acceptanceCriteria: No endorsement implication, exact return, competing claim negative cases.

features.purpose: Search, claim, join, duplicate resolution and invitation entry.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Existing Firestore organization resolution, claims, memberships and invitations.
features.dataImplications: No PostgreSQL organization or membership rows migrate.
features.authorizationImplications: Firebase user resolution and current organization authority commands only.
features.uiImplications: Compare user experience; bind to current routes/services.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Auth emulator, duplicate resolution, claim evidence, revoked/competing claims.
